source.raw_extract:
## Priority Deadlines, 2027-28 Academic Year

**QuestBridge:** November 1, 2026

**Early Action (US Citizens and Permanent Residents):** November 1, 2026

**Early Action (International Citizens):** December 1, 2026

**Regular Decision:** February 15, 2027

**Transfer Students:** April 1, 2027
source.notes: The shard's official_source_url (https://admissions.yale.edu/affordability) carries the same timeline but without years, so it cannot yield a calendar date. Following the source hierarchy upward, the official Yale Office of Undergraduate Financial Aid page finaid.yale.edu/apply/prospective gives explicit calendar dates for the 2027-28 cycle, which is a current open/upcoming cycle as of 2026-10-05. The field_mapping value 2026-12-01 is the earliest deadline that applies to this record's scope (International Citizens) - the Early Action priority deadline. The page also states a second, later applicable deadline for international citizens: "Regular Decision: February 15, 2027". These are two different admission rounds for the same aid requirement, not a source conflict, so only the earliest applicable one was written to the single-value deadline field; if the integrator prefers the Regular Decision round, the alternative value is 2027-02-15 from the same quote. Both dates are after today, so neither is stale. Confidence is MEDIUM only because of which of two published rounds populates a single-value field, not because the dates themselves are uncertain.

records.title: Errol Walton Barrow Scholarships
records.deadline_display: Completed application forms must be submitted no later than August 6, 2026.

source.publisher: Ministry of Education Transformation, Government of Barbados
source.raw_extract: Further information pertaining to the scholarship and application forms can be obtained online from the Ministry of Education Transformation website ... or in the Tertiary Section, Ministry of Technological and Vocational Training ... Completed application forms must be submitted **no later than August 6, 2026.**
source.exact_deadline_wording: Completed application forms must be submitted no later than August 6, 2026.
source.notes: Two current official Ministry of Education Transformation pages describe the SAME 2026 Errol Walton Barrow Scholarship cycle and give DIFFERENT closing dates. Page A (https://education.gov.bb/2026-errol-walton-barrow-scholarships, news item July 27, 2026) states: "Completed application forms must be submitted no later than August 6, 2026." Page B (https://education.gov.bb/errol-walton-barrow-scholarships-2026/, news item June 3, 2026) states: "Completed application forms must be submitted no later than July 3rd, 2026." Page A is the later announcement and is the source recorded here, but both are official and neither is withdrawn, so this is recorded as CONFLICTING with deadline_date null rather than picking one. Independently, both candidate dates are already in the past relative to retrieval (2026-10-05), so writing either would also be a stale value. The shard's prior note that 'the next round is expected in the same annual cycle' is an inference about recurrence, not a published deadline, and was not converted into a date; the Ministry's Latest News page shows no 2027 call at the time of retrieval.
